purpose: Measure longer matched worker invocations after the 32-lane 64-step panel showed process-start overhead and baseline drift.
frozen_inputs: same mixed-dp40-cpu job.bin and in.bin files as attempt 2; launcher expands active states deterministically
primary_measure: candidate full-process elapsed_ns divided by the within-repeat median of bracketing baseline elapsed_ns, reported per curve
validity: all outputs, distinguished points and actual steps must match exactly; every source and launcher hash and all raw files retained
noise_control: report each baseline bracket max/min ratio; a bracket above 1.05 bars a speed claim for that repeat

outcomes.candidate_faster_with_stable_brackets: retain as a bounded full-process throughput signal and seek independent replication before selecting an optimization
outcomes.candidate_slower_with_stable_brackets: investigate GPU code generation and consider removing or replacing the optimization
outcomes.mixed_or_unstable: record inconclusive timing and use profiler or controlled kernel-only measurement

claim_scope: worker invocation throughput on this L4 workload only; no fleet, collection-cost or ECDLP cost conclusion
